Gold fh-001: father died of bowel cancer 10 years ago (no age). Generated adds age 62, which is extra but not contradictory.

Generated adds toast and jam and specifically advises avoiding dairy, meat, fish, and eggs, which is not supported and conflicts with later recommendation to use yogurts (a dairy) as probiotics.
